prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ lookupBinSnapshot }`.

`async lookupBinSnapshot(label, resolveBin, readBin)` coordinates two caller-supplied asynchronous functions without performing I/O itself.

Requirements:
- `label` must be a string whose trimmed value is nonempty; otherwise throw `TypeError`.
- `resolveBin` and `readBin` must be functions; otherwise throw `TypeError` before invoking either.
- Await `resolveBin(trimmedLabel)`. It must yield exactly usable coordinates: an object with integer `aisle >= 0` and integer `bay >= 1`; otherwise throw `TypeError` and do not call `readBin`.
- Await `readBin(aisle, bay)`. It must yield an array. Every entry must be an object with a nonempty string `sku` and an integer `units >= 0`; otherwise throw `TypeError`.
- Return `{ aisle, bay, items }`, preserving item order. `items` and every item object must be newly allocated, so later caller mutation of provider results cannot alter the returned value.
- An empty item array is valid. Rejections from either provider must propagate unchanged. Do not mutate the label or either provider result.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
